stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2024): the applied/admitted/enrolled totals are 17,593 / 15,454 / 2,268. Oakland did not report the in-state, out-of-state and international residency breakdown, so no international admit rate is shown (the overall rate is 88%). The male/female admit rows are inconsistent with the applicant rows (men admitted 9,207 vs 7,032 applied), so only the totals are used. Undergraduate enrollment is 12,587 ('Total undergraduates') and the international (nonresident alien) count is 243. No waitlist, early decision or early action, no application closing date, rolling notification beginning July 1. SAT 79% (1,782 students) and ACT 5% (115) submitted scores.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set: SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'; the Common Data Set note says they are recommended for additional scholarship consideration and course placement.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (labelled 2025-2026); the figures from Oakland's international page replace these. Only the college's own non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 127 nonresident undergraduates received it (average $5,851)
